verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm docs.agora.io serves an llms.txt (HTTP 200) described as machine-readable indexes of the complete documentation. Per-page markdown docs are also served and explicitly direct AI agents to that index, and first-party docs invite users to let a coding agent build with Agora. Missing for 10: no evidence on the depth or completeness of the llms.txt content (e.g., a full-text variant), and no independent community corroboration of agents using it in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
